column1: # Release ladders as the remote itself reports them. `git ls-remote` only — no API, no auth.

column5: ladder lives in HEADS; convention stable across releases
ladder STOPS at Sumac — a heads-only probe is two named releases stale
releases after Sumac exist only as TAGS, and the prefix changed from `open-release/` to `release/` (P977)
cross-check: the distribution that actually gets deployed is three named releases past the newest open-release head
